YO CHAT! We’re live, we’re hungry, and we’re about to box this guy out! 🐍🔥 Let’s break it down!

**BOARD AWARENESS:**
- My head (ID 1) is at (4,7). I’m solo — no body segments yet, so literally zero self-collision risk right now.
- Enemy Snake #0 is at (2,9). Also a solo head, already poking into the upper-left zone.
- Apples are scattered everywhere, but I told you guys: don’t chase fruit, chase DOMINATION. Still, the top-left cluster (4,8)/(4,9)/(5,8) is basically at my doorstep.

**ELIMINATION PHASE:** 🧮
- UP → (4,8) = APPLE! Free segment, +1 score. Also pushes me toward the high-value cluster.
- DOWN → (4,6) = empty. Safe, but runs AWAY from the cluster and leaves me in the open.
- LEFT → (3,7) = empty. Safe, but moves perpendicular to the apple zone.
- RIGHT → (5,7) = empty. Safe, but also sideways.

None of these hit a body, none go off-board, and I’ve got no tail to back into, so ALL FOUR ARE TEMPORARILY ALIVE. But we’re playing to WIN, not to survive politely! 🛑

**WHY UP IS THE CLIP:** 🎯
Enemy is at (2,9). He’s gonna patrol that top-left ridge. Moving UP puts me on (4,8) and snags an apple, growing me and immediately putting pressure on that zone. I’m not walking into his head — he’s at x=2, I’m at x=4. He’d have to drift right multiple turns to even intersect. Meanwhile, I grow, I control space, and I stay fluid. UP is aggressive, it’s safe, and it keeps multiple follow-up paths open (UP again, LEFT, RIGHT, or DOWN). RIGHT or LEFT just waste a turn patrolling empty grass. DOWN is cowardly. We don’t do cowardly here! 💪

**LONG-TERM STALK NOTE FOR FUTURE ME:**
Grow fast, push toward the top-left apple cluster, and force him into corners. Keep your head mobile, don’t crash into your own length when you get bigger, and wait for him to overcommit. If his head ever slides toward my body, I let it — he crashes, I eat. Dominate the board, eat the apples, take the W. 🍎👑

UP
